title: Synthetic stress harness + signalization for per-route/model/region p95 & p99
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Add a synthetic stress and signalization pipeline that produces stable p95/p99 latency metrics broken down by route, model variant, and region. Deliver dashboards, baseline storage, and regression detectors tied into our alerting pipeline. This work complements our token/sec load harness and fills gaps in per-slice tail observability so we can detect regressions introduced by kernel changes, batching heuristics, or quantization variants.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic load job (stressbench) can be targeted at any route+model+region combination and produce token/sec and latency histograms
Computed p95 and p99 rollups are stored in the metrics cluster with tags: route, model, model_variant, region, batch_profile, kv_cache_enabled
Dashboards: a heatmap view showing p95/p99 over time for all routes and models by region, and a detail view with sparkline + recent synthetic run overlays
Regression detector emits alerts when p95 or p99 increases beyond baseline using a statistical test (bootstrap CI or ADWIN) and attaches the last synthetic run artifacts
Integrations: alert links to a reproducible synthetic job, and a quick link to the corresponding PR if the change was linked to a deploy
End-to-end test runs in CI that validate pipeline ingestion for a synthetic run and generate a dashboard snapshot
implementation_notes: Leverage HDR or t-digest summaries from the runner to derive p95/p99; store rollups as 1m and 1h aggregates
Extend the current load harness (stressbench) to emit histogram proto + tokens/sec baseline in same export format as production telemetry
Create a new aggregation job (rollup-service) that tags metrics by route/model/region and computes windowed quantiles; use existing metrics namespace 'synth_latency'
Choose regression algorithm: implement a primary path using bootstrap confidence intervals on p95 with 95% CI and a secondary streaming detector (ADWIN) for faster drift detection
Correlate anomalies with: recent kernel builds, batching policy changes, kv-cache toggle, quantization profile; attach metadata blobs to alerts
Retention: keep full histogram blobs for 30 days, aggregated rollups for 180 days for trend analysis
Cost: synthetic runs should be rate-limited and run on dedicated infra to avoid affecting production capacity
test_plan: Create synthetic job templates: low-latency (burst), steady-state (tokens/sec target), and congested (varying sequence lengths)
Run templates across three regions and three model families to validate tagging and storage
Introduce a small, controlled regression in a preprod kernel and verify detector fires within configured threshold
Run CI job that executes a short synthetic run and asserts presence of p95/p99 rollups in metrics cluster
Manual UX review: PM and Design to validate dashboard layouts and drilldowns
monitoring_and_alerting: Create alert rule 'synth-latency-regression' scoped to product teams with suppression during deploy windows
Alert payload must include last synthetic run ID, p95/p99 delta, affected route/model/region, and probable cause hints
Add SLO guardrail: if synthetic p99 exceeds 3x baseline for any high-traffic route, trigger on-call paging
Expose a read-only dashboard to customers (enterprise) summarizing SLA adherence (optional)
